title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Temporary Assistant Accountant - Reading - Hybrid - £15-£16 per hour

About the Client

Our client is a growing organisation, offering an opportunity to join a small, friendly and highly collaborative finance team.

They believe in open communication and transparency, building trust and fostering strong relationships with employees and clients alike. With a supportive working environment and exposure across the wider finance function, this is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to continue developing their accounting career.

About the Job

Reporting directly to the Group Accountant, the Assistant Accountant will take responsibility for a range of transactional and month-end accounting activities while supporting the smooth running of the wider finance function.

The position offers varied exposure across billing, accounts receivable, reconciliations and financial reporting, with the scope to become increasingly involved in statutory accounting, analysis and finance projects as the role develops.

Duties will include:
- Coordinating the monthly billing cycle and ensuring customer invoices are produced correctly and on schedule.
- Maintaining the accounts receivable ledger, monitoring overdue balances and assisting with credit control activity.
- Completing bank, credit card and employee expense reconciliations.
- Assisting with monthly and annual financial close activities.
- Producing balance sheet reconciliations and investigating differences where required.
- Processing intercompany transactions, including invoices and internal recharges.
- Providing additional support to the Accounts Payable function and helping resolve queries.
- Assisting with the annual external audit by preparing supporting information and responding to requests.
- Completing relevant regulatory and statistical returns.
- Maintaining accurate financial records, systems and supporting documentation.
- Supporting the Group Accountant with analysis, statutory accounts preparation and other finance-related projects.
- Identifying opportunities to improve existing finance processes and working practices.
- Working closely with colleagues and stakeholders across the wider organisation.

About the Successful Applicant

You will be a part-qualified CIMA or ACCA accountant with good experience of finance systems and strong Microsoft Excel skills. Highly numerate and detail-focused, you will be comfortable working to deadlines while maintaining accuracy. You will bring an organised, proactive and self-motivated approach, alongside the confidence and flexibility to manage changing priorities and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation.

What You Will Receive in Return

You will join a friendly and supportive finance team where you can broaden your accounting experience and continue your professional development.

title: Assistant Management Accountant
description:
Equifind are representing a SaaS firm based in Windsor, who are looking to hire an Assistant Management Accountant.

The firm boasts a leading position in the technology sector globally. After a run of record-breaking years, the organisation is now looking to grow both by number of employees and AUM in 2026, making it a very exciting time to join the business.

The position can start immediately so the right candidate will either be immediately available to start and interview or on a very short notice period. You will be supporting and assisting the team with accounts payable from start to finish through and through. Other accounting tasks will be introduced later on down the line which will allow you to gain more exposure to various roles and further develop your understanding of finance as a whole.

The Role:

The key responsibilities for the Assistant Management Accountant for the SaaS firm based in Windsor will be:
- Monitor and organise the accounts payable inbox.
- Process invoices received and their entry into the general ledger for processing.
- Review and code invoices before sending to appropriate team members for approval.
- Preparing and processing weekly payment runs.
- Perform supplier reconciliations between supplier statements and the general ledger, including more complex utility reconciliations.
- Prepare the quarterly purchase ledger report with comments on current status, ready for review/discussion.
- Liaise with suppliers to maintain relationships and to request refunds, statements and missing invoices.
- Process reports to review disputed items and follow up and chase authorisers/suppliers to resolve these.
- Process reports to flag invoices that are still awaiting approval after 3-months and chase authorisers/suppliers to resolve these.
- Process other ad-hoc reports as required.
- Prepare quarterly purchase ledger write-off report for CFO to approve.
- Assist with other ad-hoc accounts analysis and support as required.

Application Criteria:
- Ideally excellent academic background with a degree in a STEM subject.
- Ideally from a Russell Group/Red Brick University but not mandatory.
- 2+ years' experience in an Finance role.
- Excellent excel and analytical skills.
- Organised and efficient.
- Excellent communicator.
- Team player.
- Able to work in a fast-paced team environment and can hit the ground running, with a track record of rolling sleeves up to get the work down while looking for improvements longer term.

Compensation:

The Assistant Management Accountant working for this SaaS company based in Windsor will be paid a competitive market-based salary.
- Full study support for the ACCA/CIMA qualifications.
- Annual performance related bonus (discretionary).
- Hybrid work pattern.
- Employer pension contribution.
- 25-days annual leave.
- Other benefits.

title: System Administrator - Linux & Cloud Infrastructure
description:
System Administrator - Linux & Cloud Infrastructure
Position Description
The Space, Defence and Intelligence business unit in CGI is a true IT Systems Integrator. We work, build, and operate bespoke, technically complex, mission-critical systems which help our clients keep us all safe and secure. We bring innovation to our clients using proven and emerging technologies, agile delivery processes and our deep expertise across the breadth of space, defence, intelligence, aerospace and maritime, all underpinned by our end-to-end cyber capability. We work collaboratively with global technology companies, cutting edge SMEs and academia to deliver the optimal solution for each client.
CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK 'Best Employer' by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you'll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We'll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go.
CGI are on the lookout for a System Administrator to join our BOREALIS team and help keep secure, business-critical cloud infrastructure performing reliably for our clients. Based on site in Reading, you'll play an important role in monitoring system health, identifying potential issues and providing responsive first-line support within a highly secure environment. You'll have the autonomy to investigate alerts, use monitoring insights to solve problems and contribute to service improvements, while collaborating with experienced technical teams when more complex challenges arise. It's an opportunity to build your expertise across Linux and cloud infrastructure, contribute ideas that strengthen service performance, and develop your career within a supportive CGI community where your contribution has a visible impact.
Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to be a sole UK National and hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This is an office-based position, requiring 5 days per week onsite at our Reading location, and participation in a 24/7 on call rota.
Your future duties and responsibilities
In this role, you will take ownership of the day-to-day monitoring and first-line support of secure cloud infrastructure, helping maintain the availability, performance and reliability of critical systems. You'll carry out daily health checks, proactively investigate alerts and use tools such as Grafana and Kibana to analyse dashboards, logs and system metrics.
You'll apply your problem-solving skills to troubleshoot incidents, resolving issues where possible and gathering the technical information needed for efficient escalation when additional expertise is required. Working alongside CGI colleagues and technical teams, you'll have opportunities to share ideas, improve ways of working and expand your knowledge. You'll also participate in a 24x 7 on-call rota, responding to critical incidents outside standard working hours when required.
- Monitor & Maintain: Conduct daily system and infrastructure health checks, monitoring availability and performance.
- Investigate & Resolve: Identify alerts and incidents, perform initial troubleshooting and resolve first-line issues.
- Analyse & Improve: Use Grafana, Kibana, dashboards, logs and system metrics to identify potential problems and support continuous improvement.
- Diagnose & Escalate: Gather complete diagnostic information, error details and system context before escalating complex issues to technical teams.
- Support & Collaborate: Deliver responsive customer support while working closely with technical colleagues to restore services efficiently.
- Respond & Protect: Participate in the 24x 7 on-call rota and respond to critical incidents when required.
Required qualifications to be successful in this role
You'll bring practical systems administration or previous cloud infrastructure support experience, with a strong grounding in Linux and confidence using monitoring and observability tools. You should be comfortable investigating technical issues methodically, interpreting system information and working collaboratively to deliver a reliable service. You'll be supported by experienced colleagues while having the scope to take ownership of issues and develop creative solutions.
Essential:
- Linux: Practical experience administering, supporting or troubleshooting Linux environments.
- Grafana: Experience using Grafana to review or create dashboards and analyse system performance.
- Kibana: Experience using Kibana to investigate logs, alerts and operational issues.
- Monitoring: Ability to interpret system metrics, logs and infrastructure health information.
- Troubleshooting: Proven ability to gather diagnostic information, investigate issues and determine appropriate next steps.
- Customer Support: Strong customer service and communication skills within a technical support environment.
- On-Call Support: Willingness and ability to participate in a 24x 7 on-call rota.
Desirable:
- Agile: Experience working within an Agile environment would be advantageous.
- Previous experience working within the space and defence sector
Together, as owners, let's turn meaningful insights into action.
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you'll reach your full potential because

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That's why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company's strategy and direction.
Your work creates value. You'll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
You'll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You'll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
Come join our team-one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: Inventory and Stock Coordinator
description:
Inventory & Stock Co-ordinator

Are you organised, proactive, and passionate about delivering excellent customer service? We are looking for an Inventory & Stock Co-ordinator to join a busy operations team in Slough.

As an Inventory & Stock Co-ordinator, you will be responsible for all aspects of physical and system-based stock management, ensuring products are received, stored, tracked and supplied efficiently. - Ensure deliveries are completed efficiently and on time.
- Maintain high standards of accuracy when completing paperwork and using IT systems.
- Build strong relationships with colleagues, technicians and customers.
- Resolve stock discrepancies and support continuous stock accuracy improvements.
- Plan, organise and prioritise workload effectively using multiple systems and applications.
- Support operational activities and undertake additional duties as required.
- Adhere to all health and safety procedures and company standards.
- Represent the business professionally at all times.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in stock control, inventory management or a stores/parts role.
- Experience within a garage, workshop, automotive, motor trade or vehicle parts environment would be highly advantageous.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- A positive, can-do attitude and willingness to learn.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Basic computer skills and confidence using IT systems.
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
- Flexible and adaptable approach to work.
